title: Ju-On: The Japanese Films
blurb: The original Japanese curse films, told in jumbled chapters that hop around in time, then restarted twice and finally crossed over with Ring.

juon14.t: Ju-On: The Beginning of the End

groups.title: The original series
groups.note: The two video films, then the two cinema films that partly remake them.

groups.title: The 10th anniversary films
groups.note: Two short standalone films about different curses.

groups.title: The 2014 reboot
groups.note: Restarts the story and changes much of the backstory.

groups.title: Sadako vs. Kayako
groups.note: A crossover with Ring, outside both series' continuity.

note: Every film is split into chapters named after characters and told out of order, so there is no clean chronology even inside a single film. The Grudge (2002) partly remakes the two video films, so you can start there. The American remakes have their own page.
